final_template:
terraform {
  required_version = ">= 1.0"
  required_providers {
    aws = {
      source  = "hashicorp/aws"
      version = "~> 5.0"
    }
  }
}

variable "rolename" {
  type        = string
  description = "The name of the IAM role to create."
  default     = "WizAccess-Role"
}

variable "remote_arn" {
  type        = string
  description = "The ARN of the remote IAM principal allowed to assume this role."
  default     = "arn:aws:iam::830522659852:role/prod-us43-AssumeRoleDelegator"
}

variable "external_id" {
  type        = string
  description = "The external ID used in the trust policy condition."
  default     = "fc959d31-537c-4108-8b87-9af9e0c9b8d2"
}

data "aws_iam_policy_document" "assume_role_policy" {
  statement {
    sid     = "AssumeRoleWithExternalId"
    effect  = "Allow"
    actions = ["sts:AssumeRole"]

    principals {
      type        = "AWS"
      identifiers = [var.remote_arn]
    }

    condition {
      test     = "StringEquals"
      variable = "sts:ExternalId"
      values   = [var.external_id]
    }
  }
}

resource "aws_iam_role" "wiz_access_role" {
  name               = var.rolename
  description        = "Cross-account IAM role for Wiz security auditing integration"
  assume_role_policy = data.aws_iam_policy_document.assume_role_policy.json
}

resource "aws_iam_role_policy_attachment" "view_only_access" {
  role       = aws_iam_role.wiz_access_role.name
  policy_arn = "arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/job-function/ViewOnlyAccess"
}

resource "aws_iam_role_policy_attachment" "security_audit" {
  role       = aws_iam_role.wiz_access_role.name
  policy_arn = "arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/SecurityAudit"
}

      "ec2:CreateSnapshot",
      "ec2:GetEbsEncryptionByDefault",
      "ec2:DescribeSnapshots"
    ]
    resources = ["*"]

  statement {
    sid    = "WizCreateTagsForSnapshots"
    effect = "Allow"
    actions = [
      "ec2:CreateTags"
    ]
    resources = ["arn:aws:ec2:*:*:snapshot/*"]
  }

  # Statement 4: KMS alias creation on the wizKey alias and on any KMS key in any region and account
  statement {
    sid    = "WizKmsAliasManagement"
    effect = "Allow"
    actions = [
      "kms:CreateAlias"
    ]
    resources = [
      "arn:aws:kms:*:*:alias/wizKey",
      "arn:aws:kms:*:*:key/*"
    ]
  }

  # Statement 5: KMS key policy actions matching a resource tag condition of aws:ResourceTag/wiz equal to auto-gen-cmk
  statement {
    sid    = "WizKmsKeyPolicyManagement"
    effect = "Allow"
    actions = [
      "kms:GetKeyPolicy",
      "kms:PutKeyPolicy"
    ]
    resources = ["*"]

    condition {
      test     = "StringEquals"
      variable = "aws:ResourceTag/wiz"
      values   = ["auto-gen-cmk"]
    }
  }

  # Statement 6: Snapshot deletion and modification matching an EC2 resource tag condition of ec2:ResourceTag/wiz equal to auto-gen-snapshot
  statement {
    sid    = "WizSnapshotDeleteAndModify"
    effect = "Allow"
    actions = [
      "ec2:DeleteSnapshot",
      "ec2:ModifySnapshotAttribute"
    ]
    resources = ["*"]

    condition {
      test     = "StringEquals"
      variable = "ec2:ResourceTag/wiz"
      values   = ["auto-gen-snapshot"]
    }
  }

  # Statement 7: Explicit Deny for s3:GetObject across all resources
  statement {
    sid       = "WizAccessS3"
    effect    = "Deny"
    actions   = ["s3:GetObject"]
    resources = ["*"]
  }
}

}
